posts.author: Samus1076
posts.body:
Hello and good day.
https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkx3QFqvatZS_1afVa7QtWPM8cEwtb86Ti0?si=LvFo38PaQiS2QpEe
I was looking for a audio manager plugin for RPG Maker MZ that actually does this FFVI-style audio fade (the one where the music echoes and fades at the same time in timestamp 0:02). After a long search, I couldn't find a plugin with said characteristics.
If there isn't, I do image two alternatives of how it is supposed to work:
1: When you turn ON the plugin, you can use the Plugin Command of the plugin that has the option "Audio Fade", which does the effect I'm searching. It lasts 1 second.
2: The same Plugin Command and the "Audio Fade" non-sense, but this time, the command is an option - True or False. If True is set on, everytime you use the End BGM option in the Event Command, the audio will fade. It would only work if the End BGM duration is set to 1 second. It doesn't need explaination what False does.
But if there IS one with the Audio Fading characteristics I'm looking for, in this here post thread, welcome it is.
Thanks.

posts.author: fugahagen
posts.body: I don't think that is even an echo. Its midi and the last few notes are allowed to "ring" while the next map loads. No midi support kills that idea pretty fast.
